description:
Why: Make Distiller Fast measured (develop 515033ca0, distiller 32,000 lines, log /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/prop/gc.dev4.jsonl): 171 minors make 2,062,817 stub_visits (~20,000/minor flat from minor 65-143 while live grows 10.9->58.3 MB); 11 majors 85,589. Cost tracks young stubs per quantum, about one stub per 30 surviving bytes. Last ~15 minors report 0 visits (unexplained).
Hypotheses (ranked): (a) in-place <> mints one ProcBin per append (heap/imp.rs alloc_concatenation, spare-room branch); (b) slices above SHARED_BIN_THRESHOLD_BYTES become stubs (alloc_bitstring_slice), including fz-nml.5 decoded-string views; (c) fresh shared buffers (alloc_concatenation overflow, alloc_bitstring_with/shared_bin_alloc_with, :binary.copy). Each predicts a different per-site distribution.
What: alloc_procbin callers name their site (enum StubSite {AppendInPlace, Slice, FreshBuffer, ...} — one per alloc_procbin caller, census the callers first); the heap counts stubs made per site since the last collection, and the sweep counts per site how many survived. fz.runtime.gc metadata gains "stubs_made":{site:n} and "stubs_survived":{site:n}. Telemetry only: no behaviour change. Docs: .agent/docs/runtime-telemetry.md.
Acceptance: telemetry_test pins the field shape; a unit/fixture test drives each site once and observes its count; run the distiller probe and report the per-site table, which answers (a)/(b)/(c) and the 0-visit tail (0 made => no bug; else stub_visits bug). Pins only fall.
title: Each GC event counts binary stubs by the site that made them, and how many survived
